sentence: From 2022-02-23 to 2026-11-23 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +41.3% a year (worst drawdown -37.0%) against +34.3% (-40.6%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks.
